verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Amplitude's own official MCP server, which is the server role. Nothing shows Amplitude Experiment acting as an MCP client that can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. The server-side evidence belongs to a different story and earns no credit here. An experimentation SaaS with AI features could plausibly consume MCP servers, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence that it does.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
